### Package Installation

```{r include=FALSE}
# Package installs 
install.packages("tidyverse")  
install.packages("data.table")
```

### Reading all csv files

```{r}
library(data.table)
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv") 
synonyms <- fread("data/synonyms.csv")
traits <- fread("data/traits.csv")
observation <- fread("data/observation.csv")
survey_header <- fread("data/header.csv")
location <- fread("data/location.csv")
```

### Perform any data manipulation here:

#### Observations Table 

##### 1. Rename columns

```{r}
library(data.table) 
## Rename columns 
observations <- fread("data/observation.csv")
setnames(observations, old = c("sd_ID", "sd_SpeciesORIG","sd_quality", "sd_Breeding"), new = c("survey_id","species_id", "survey_quality", "breeding_status"), skip_absent = TRUE)   
colnames(observations) 
```

##### 2. Cleaning

```{r}
# removing rejected records from observation table
unique(observations$survey_quality)  
```

#### Species

##### 1. Rename species table

```{r}
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv")  
setnames(species, old = c("spNo", "sName", "sciName","IOC_Species_ID", "species_Notes", "observation_Count"), new = c("species_id", "species_name", "species_sciname", "ioc_species_id", "species_notes", "observation_count"), skip_absent = TRUE)   
colnames(species) 
```

#### Locations

```{r}
locations <- fread("data/location.csv")
colnames(locations)
setnames(locations, old = c("bl_ID", "bl_Location", "bl_Lat", "bl_Lon", "region_Code", "header_Count", "Min_Alt", "Max_Alt"), new = c("location_id", "location_name", "latitude", "longitude", "region_code", "header_count", "min_altitude", "max_altitude"),  skip_absent = TRUE) 
colnames(locations)
```

#### Header Table 

```{r}
survey_header <- fread("data/header.csv")  

old_names = c("s_ID", "s_Atlasser", "s_StartF", "s_DateL", "s_Latitude", "s_Longitude", "s_Locality", "k_Latitude", "k_Longitude", "observation_count", "s_Qualifier", "s_Notes")  
new_names = c("survey_id", "survey_atlasser", "survey_start", "survey_end", "latitude", "longitude", "survey_location", "key_latitude", "key_longitude", "observation_count", "survey_qualifier", "survey_notes")
setnames(survey_header, old_names, new_names, skip_absent = TRUE)  

colnames(survey_header)
```

### Make new tables via joins

##### Adding a column for species names

```{r}
# make sure join keys are the same type (bit you before with DB_Code)
species[, species_id := as.character(species_id)]
observations[, species_id := as.character(species_id)]

setkey(species, species_id)
setkey(observations, species_id)

observations <- observations[species, on = "species_id"]
```

```{r}
# observations don't have any spatial information 
# Survey header has lat, long, loc 

setkey(observations, survey_id) 
setkey(survey_header, survey_id) 

observations <- observations[survey_header, on = "survey_id",.(survey_id, species_id, species_name, species_sciname, survey_location, key_latitude, key_longitude, survey_quality, survey_start, survey_end, confidence_Level, survey_notes)] 
colnames(observations)
```

```{r}
# using key_latitude, key_longitude, Left join locations on observations to get min alt and max alt. 
```

### Data Viz

##### Pie chart of Birds observed

```{r}
library(ggplot2) 

species_summary <- species[order(-observation_count)]

# --- Option A: Pie chart, top N + "Other" ---
top_n <- 5
species_summary[, group := ifelse(.I <= top_n, species_name, "Other")]

plot_data <- species_summary[, .(total_count = sum(observation_count)), by = group]

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = "", y = total_count, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(title = "Observations by Species", fill = "Species") +
  theme_void()
```
